newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht eases late, interbank rate steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht eases late, interbank rate steady.

text.p: The Thai baht was slightly lower late on Thursday in the domestic market amid persistent demand for the dollar, dealers said.
The baht was quoted at 30.10/30.20 per dollar late in onshore market against 30.08/30.15 in the early morning.
"There was demand for the dollar. But the dollar buying is not so strong today," said one dealer at a major local bank.
The central bank on Thursday said the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 30.062 per dollar against 29.967 on Wednesday.
Dealers said they had not detected any signs of Bank of Thailand's intervention in the market to keep the baht steady.
In the offshore market, the baht was traded at 29.90/30.10 late compared with 29.90/30.00 in morning trade.
The baht/dollar one-month swap premium was at 27/32 satangs per dollar in the onshore market and 70/75 offshore.
The overnight interbank rate was about steady at 17-19 percent in late trade compared with 19 percent in the morning.

Dealers said the interbank rate would remain at a relatively high level this week on strong demand for funds from banks ahead of a long weekend. Monday is a public holiday to commemorate the start of the Buddhist Lent.
